issues: No way around the measurement found. The new code reads no files and pastes in no answers. It uses test_smiles only to build features. No test labels are used.

No bugs found that would make the result meaningless. The SVR kernel is the average of Tanimoto kernels on Morgan fingerprints of radius 1, 2 and 3. An average of valid kernels is still a valid kernel. The train-vs-train and test-vs-train matrices are lined up correctly. The random forest and LightGBM parts did not change.

Recomputed z: the gap is 0.5027 - 0.5023 = 0.0004. Divided by 0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1) ≈ 0.0099, that gives about 0.040. The harness reports 0.037, which fits once you allow for the 4-decimal rounding of the inputs. Either way the gain is far inside the noise, so the provisional decision to reject is right.
Minor: each fit now builds fingerprints 3 more times, with no gain that can be measured. On simplicity grounds alone, rejecting is justified.
